import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_35/test_0.csv"
    
    # Target output path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_35/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    
    # Load source data
    df_source = pd.read_csv(source_path)
    
    # Ensure correct data types
    df_source['Source Zipcode'] = df_source['Source Zipcode'].astype(int)
    df_source['Counts'] = df_source['Counts'].astype(int)
    
    # Aggregate counts by Source Zipcode
    df_target = df_source.groupby('Source Zipcode', as_index=False)['Counts'].sum()
    
    # Write to target CSV
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
    
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
